title: Helper-script entry guard: fall back to the lexical comparison when realpath throws, share one helper, fix the 8.3 comment
outcome:
A Low and two Notes from review delegation-b8dc85b3 on the entry-guard fix of w-ae4b52018e7f.
(1) invokedDirectly in scripts/test-launcher.mjs, scripts/test-temp-root.mjs and scripts/review-freeze-fingerprint.mjs returns false when realpathSync.native throws, which is a silent exit 0. Examples: Windows volumes without final-path support, some RAM disks and bind mounts, or an unreadable parent directory. On such volumes the old lexical guard ran the script. Fix: in the catch, fall back to the lexical comparison, so the new guard is never weaker than the old one.
(2) Optionally share one invokedDirectly(moduleUrl) helper, since test-launcher already imports test-temp-root.
(3) The comment in test-launcher.mjs names an 8.3 spelling as a cause. The reviewer reads Node's loader as not expanding short names for the main module, so drop that example unless a test shows otherwise.
acceptance: The entry-guard comment names only the aliases the code actually handles.
When realpath throws, each helper's entry guard falls back to comparing the lexical resolved paths, and a test that forces the throw shows the script still runs.
